user-1.title: print cannot label its output
user-1.body:
Program: print 2 * 3 + 4
I wanted to label the output as total. The toy language has no text, so I had to guess the layout.
Message: none, the program ran. The gap is the missing text.

user-2.title: Long sums with parentheses are hard to check
user-2.body:
Program: print ((1 + 2) * (3 + 4)) - 5
The output is right, but the spec says nothing about how an unbalanced parenthesis is reported beyond E0003.
Message: none.
